name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah Yojana
benefit: - Under the scheme, an amount of ₹5,000/- will be given at the time of marriage of the girl child.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a girl who is 18 years of age or older at the time of application. 1. The applicant should be a native of Bihar. 1. The applicant's family should be Below Poverty Line (BPL) card holders. 1. The annual income of the applicant's family should not exceed ₹60,000/-. 1. The applicant should be marrying a boy who is 21 years of age or older.
